differences.aspect: hidden random source and persistent operation sequence
differences.native: LeetCode constructs Solution(m, n), supplies randrange(), and calls flip() or reset() on the persistent object.
differences.app: solve(m, n, random_values, operations) derives deterministic randrange tickets and dispatches the authored flip/reset trace over the same persistent state.
differences.rationale: The offline judge must expose randomness and method calls as reproducible data. The virtual-array state, sparse Fisher-Yates remapping, flip return, reset behavior, and expected constant-time operations are otherwise identical.
